duration.$description: Durations. The Figma prototype uses 100 ms micro feedback, 200 ms spinner frames, 300 ms for hovers, tooltips and tabs, 600 ms and 1200 ms for ambient glows, and 800 ms for the success confetti.

shake.$description: The refusal shake of a field, a budget or the energy pill (today's InputField shake).

pulse.$description: One breath of a loading skeleton (today's MUI Skeleton pulse).

ease.$description: Easing curves. standard, in-out and back are the Figma prototype curves (ease out, ease in and out, ease in back); pop is an overshoot for small success moments; recoil is today's field shake curve.

spring.$description: Spring presets for Motion, from the Figma prototype springs (Quick, Gentle, Slow).

stagger.$description: Delay between items that animate in sequence (Motion staggerChildren): list for menus, rows and KPI chips, reveal for the round results sequence.

layer.$description: Stacking order (z-index) of everything that floats. Header, drawer, modal, toast and tooltip match MUI's scale (1100, 1200, 1300, 1400, 1500), so layers from both libraries stack correctly while they coexist.

popover.$description: Menus, selects and popovers, which can open inside a modal.

celebration.$description: Confetti and fireworks: above everything, never catching the pointer.
